hero_kpi_rationale_de: Die wiederkehrenden Versicherungsprämieneinnahmen (12,7 Mrd. EUR) sind der grundlegende Treiber der Gruppe, mit stabilem Wachstum (+4 % YoY) und hoher Vorhersehbarkeit.

kpis.signal_de: High margin supported by rigorous cost management.
Very high gross margin typical of an integrated insurance model.
Slight headcount reduction, in line with increasing automation.
Low R&D, consistent with an insurance rather than pure-tech model.
Moderate capex focused on information systems and automation.
Stable recurring flows, a group valuation driver with double-digit growth
Dividend per share of EUR 0.36 last year.
Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of EUR 0.915 Bn last year.
